mapper.select: SELECT FROM board_posts p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN board_calendar_dates c ON c.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN board_popup_settings s ON s.post_id = p.post_id WHERE ORDER BY p.pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM board_posts p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN board_calendar_dates c ON c.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN board_popup_settings s ON s.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_posts (board_type, author_id, title, content_json, content_html, content_text, image_file_id, pinned) VALUES (#{boardType}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{contentJson}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentText}, #{imageFileId}, #{pinned})

INSERT INTO board_popup_settings (post_id, target_path, include_children, enabled, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{postId}, #{targetPath}, #{includeChildren}, #{enabled}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_path = VALUES(target_path), include_children = VALUES(include_children), enabled = VALUES(enabled), start_date = VALUES(start_date), end_date = VALUES(end_date)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM board_posts p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.author_id JOIN board_popup_settings s ON s.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN board_calendar_dates c ON c.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.board_type = 'POPUP' AND s.enabled = TRUE AND s.start_date <= #{today} AND s.end_date >= #{today} AND (s.target_path = #{path} OR (s.include_children = TRUE AND (s.target_path = '/' OR LEFT(#{path}, CHAR_LENGTH(s.target_path) + 1) = CONCAT(s.target_path, '/')))) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE board_posts SET title = #{title}, content_json = #{contentJson}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, content_text = #{contentText}, image_file_id = #{imageFileId}, pinned = #{pinned}, version_number = version_number + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND version_number = #{versionNumber} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_calendar_dates (post_id, event_date, event_end_date) VALUES (#{postId}, #{eventDate}, #{eventEndDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_date = VALUES(event_date), event_end_date = VALUES(event_end_date)
mapper.update: UPDATE board_posts SET use_yn = 'N', version_number = version_number + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND version_number = #{versionNumber} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE board_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_answers (post_id, author_id, content_json, content_html, content_text) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{contentJson}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentText})
mapper.update: UPDATE board_posts SET answered = #{answered} WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
